restaurant_name: Smile Plus Jom Tien Dental Clinic
text: Very unpleasant experience! I came here to have my teeth cleaned and tartar removed. The week before, I was told the price would be 900-1200 baht. When I arrived, the price had changed to 1500 baht. The dentist entered without a smile, and with a directly unfriendly demeanor. I took my place in the dental chair and immediately felt that something was not right. The dentist did not support her hand on my jaw, resulting in imprecise handling of the tool used to remove tartar. She hit my gums several times, causing a lot of bleeding and hitting spots that resulted in a lot of pain. I got up after 10 minutes, paid, and left as I did not feel I was in safe hands. Not recommended!
